title: 现在完成时（have/has+done，表过去动作对现在的影响）
knowledgePoint: 现在完成时的核心结构（have/has+过去分词）、时间状语搭配（since/for/already/yet/so far等）、与一般过去时的区别（影响持续vs动作完成）、否定句与疑问句形式、多场景应用（经历/持续/结果）

questions.question: The research team ______ significant progress in developing renewable energy technologies—their findings ______ published in top journals over the past three years.
questions.explanation: 第一空“取得进展”强调对现在的影响（技术研发有成果），用现在完成时has made；第二空“over the past three years”是现在完成时标志，“研究结果被发表”用被动语态have been published，符合规则。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 现在完成时的核心语义：过去动作持续到现在或对现在产生影响，常搭配for/since/over the past+时间段等状语。

questions.question: She has joined the company for five years and has been promoted twice—she is now a department manager.
questions.explanation: join是短暂性动词，不能与for+时间段搭配，需改为持续性动词be in/work in，即“She has been in the company for five years”，题干短暂性动词误用，语法错误。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 常见短暂性动词转换：join→be in/be a member of；buy→have；leave→be away；die→be dead。

questions.question: — ______ you ______ the new policy announced by the government? — Yes, I ______ it this morning. It ______ a positive impact on small businesses.
options: Have; read; have read; has had
Did; read; have read; has had
questions.explanation: 第一空询问“是否已阅读”（经历/对现在的了解），用现在完成时Have; read；第二空“今早阅读”是具体过去动作，用一般过去时read；第三空“产生积极影响”强调对现在的结果，用has had，符合时态逻辑。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 现在完成时表“经历/结果”，一般过去时表“具体过去动作”，两者需根据语境区分。

questions.question: They have not finished the project yet, but they have made great efforts—they will submit it before the deadline next week.
questions.explanation: “not...yet”是现在完成时否定式标志，表“尚未完成”；“made great efforts”强调过去努力对现在的影响（接近完成），语法正确，逻辑连贯。
questions.knowledgeExtension: yet常用于现在完成时否定句和疑问句末尾，表“还/尚未”；already常用于肯定句，表“已经”（可位于句中或句末）。

questions.question: The number of people using electric vehicles ______ sharply over the past decade—this ______ largely due to environmental awareness and policy support.
questions.explanation: 第一空“over the past decade”是现在完成时标志，“数量增长”用has increased；第二空“原因是……”是客观事实，用一般现在时is，符合语境。
questions.knowledgeExtension: the number of+复数名词作主语时，谓语动词用单数；a number of+复数名词作主语时，谓语动词用复数。

questions.question: He has visited Paris three times—his first trip was in 2015, and he has gone there again last month.
questions.explanation: last month是明确过去时间状语，不能与现在完成时搭配，需改为一般过去时went，题干时态搭配错误。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 明确过去时间状语（yesterday/last week/in 2020等）只能搭配一般过去时，不能搭配现在完成时。

questions.question: — How long ______ you ______ English? — For ten years. I ______ my first English class when I was six years old.
questions.explanation: 第一空“how long”搭配现在完成时have; learned，表“持续学习十年”；第二空“六岁时上第一节课”是具体过去动作，用一般过去时took，符合规则。
questions.knowledgeExtension: how long询问动作持续时间时，若动作持续到现在，用现在完成时；若动作已结束，用一般过去时。

questions.question: So far, the company has launched three new products this year—all of them have received positive feedback from consumers.
questions.explanation: “so far”是现在完成时标志，表“到目前为止”；“launch products”和“receive feedback”均强调过去动作对现在的结果，时态使用正确。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 常见现在完成时标志词：so far/up to now/until now/in the past+时间段/over the years等。

questions.question: She ______ as a doctor for 15 years—she ______ in this hospital since she graduated from medical school.
questions.explanation: 第一空“15年医生经历”强调持续到现在，用has worked；第二空“since+过去从句”是现在完成时标志，用has worked，保持时态一致。
questions.knowledgeExtension: since引导的从句用一般过去时，主句用现在完成时，表“自从……以来一直做某事”。

questions.question: I have lost my keys—I can’t find them anywhere. I must have left them at the office this morning.
questions.explanation: “丢钥匙”强调对现在的影响（找不到），用现在完成时have lost；“今早落在办公室”是具体过去推测，用一般过去时left，逻辑通顺，语法正确。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 现在完成时表“过去动作导致现在结果”，常与can’t/needn’t等情态动词搭配，体现结果影响。

questions.question: — ______ the team ______ the championship yet? — No, the final match ______ next weekend. They ______ hard for months to prepare for it.
options: Did; win; will be held; trained
Have; won; will be held; have been training
Have; won; is held; have trained
questions.correctAnswer: Have; won; will be held; have been training
questions.explanation: 第一空“yet”提示用现在完成时Have; won；第二空“下周末决赛”用一般将来时被动will be held；第三空“数月来努力训练”强调持续到现在，用现在完成进行时have been training，符合时态逻辑。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 现在完成时与现在完成进行时的区别：前者侧重结果/经历，后者侧重持续过程（如have trained表“已训练”，have been training表“一直在训练”）。

questions.question: We have known each other since we were in primary school—we have been good friends for more than 20 years.
questions.explanation: “since+过去从句”搭配现在完成时have known，“for+时间段”搭配have been，均表“持续到现在的关系”，语法正确，语义连贯。
questions.knowledgeExtension: know是静态动词，无进行时，表“持续认识”用现在完成时have known。

questions.question: The environmental pollution ______ a serious problem in many cities. Governments ______ various measures to address it, but more work ______ needed.
questions.explanation: 第一空“污染成为严重问题”强调对现在的影响，用has become；第二空“政府采取措施”表过去动作持续到现在，用have taken；第三空“需要更多工作”是客观事实，用一般现在时is，符合语境。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 现在完成时可用于描述社会现象、问题等，强调从过去到现在的发展变化。

questions.question: She has written three novels since 2018—her latest one has come out last month and sold well.
questions.explanation: last month是明确过去时间，“新书出版”需用一般过去时came out，题干用现在完成时，时态搭配错误。
questions.knowledgeExtension: come out（出版/发行）是短暂性动词，表具体时间发生的动作，用一般过去时；表“是否已出版”的结果，用现在完成时（如Has the book come out yet?）。

questions.question: — Why ______ you ______ to the meeting? — I ______ an urgent call from my client. I ______ no choice but to deal with it immediately.
questions.explanation: 第一空询问“为何没参会”（对现在的影响：会议可能已进行或结束），用现在完成时haven’t; come；第二空“接到紧急电话”是具体过去动作，用received；第三空“别无选择”是过去的状态，用had，符合逻辑。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 现在完成时可用于询问“未做某事的原因”，强调动作未发生对现在的影响。

questions.question: Up to now, scientists have not found a cure for the disease, but they have made significant breakthroughs in research.
questions.explanation: “up to now”是现在完成时标志，“未找到治愈方法”和“取得突破”均强调过去动作对现在的结果，时态使用正确。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 现在完成时的否定式：have/has not+过去分词，表“过去动作未发生或持续未完成”。

questions.question: The city ______ a lot since I left it five years ago. Many new buildings ______ and the traffic ______ much better.
options: has changed; have been built; has become
has changed; were built; has become
questions.correctAnswer: has changed; have been built; has become
questions.explanation: 第一空“since+过去从句”用has changed，表“城市变化”；第二空“新建筑被建造”用现在完成时被动have been built；第三空“交通变好”用has become，均强调过去到现在的变化，符合时态规则。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 描述“离开某地后发生的变化”，常用“since I left+现在完成时”的结构，突出变化的持续性。

questions.question: He has been to Beijing many times—he has gone there again last week to attend a conference.
questions.explanation: last week是明确过去时间，“去北京”需用一般过去时went，has gone表“去了未回”，且不能与过去时间搭配，题干时态和动词用法均错误。
questions.knowledgeExtension: have been to表“去过某地（已回）”，have gone to表“去了某地（未回）”，两者不可混淆，且均不能与明确过去时间搭配。

questions.question: — ______ you ______ the movie “Oppenheimer”? — Yes, I ______ it last month. I ______ it twice because it’s really impressive.
options: Did; see; have seen; have seen
questions.explanation: 第一空询问“是否看过”（经历），用Have; seen；第二空“上个月看”是具体过去动作，用saw；第三空“看过两次”强调经历次数，用have seen，符合现在完成时表“经历”的用法。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 现在完成时表“经历”时，常与次数（once/twice）、ever/never等搭配，不强调具体时间。

questions.question: They have been working on the experiment for three months—they have not achieved the expected result, but they will continue their efforts.
questions.explanation: “for three months”搭配现在完成进行时have been working，表“持续进行的实验”；“未取得预期结果”用现在完成时have not achieved，强调对现在的影响，语法正确，逻辑连贯。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 现在完成进行时更侧重“动作持续进行的过程”，现在完成时侧重“动作的结果或状态”，两者可在同一语境中搭配使用。
